isolation: Signed in once as test-cook-1 (Maria, role Cook) via the development IdP. The account is shared across validation runs and already held many recipes with titles overlapping the scenario text (Grandma's Chili, Pancakes, Garden Salad, ** Lemon Bars). Each scenario that needs a recipe creates its own fresh instance through the app's own New Recipe / Import forms and captures that instance's id/URL immediately, then asserts against that specific instance (by navigating straight to its detail page, or by checking that the newly created row - always the most recent, topmost row - carries the expected fields) rather than searching the whole collection by title. For the two scenarios with no natural container (empty meal plan -> shopping list, discard draft), isolation is a before/after count or specific-id check: the meal plan's 7 days were read and confirmed empty before generating, and the discard scenario recorded the exact row count of title-matching recipes before and after discarding. Search/filter scenarios (searching by title, filtering by category) assert that every row returned by the query matches the expected title/category and that no row of the other named recipe appears, which holds regardless of pre-existing duplicates.

steps.observed: no draft was produced (correct, half of this Then holds), but the only message shown is "The import agent could not be reached. Try again." — this tells Maria the import AGENT is unreachable, not that her URL/link could not be reached, and the underlying 422 body confirms the real cause was a URL-validity guardrail rejection, not a connectivity failure to the agent
